title: 第12章 脚踏六条船，翻船了
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“百里魇！”昭杺柠盯着凑近的男人惊呼。

反应过来自己现在在问天宗，吓得她连忙抬手捂嘴，低声质问百里魇：“我滴个魔尊啊，这里是问天宗，你怎么敢来的？”

对于百里魇的真容，昭杺柠印象深刻。

虽然两人初见时，百里魇伪装成了乞丐也看不清相貌。

但昭杺柠对于自己怎么进入游戏修仙世界还是记得的。

全因为那六个男主的美貌海报勾引的她。

不然她也不会一时‘色’迷心窍，最后被系统绑定穿越。

“放心，问天宗没人能发现本尊在这。”面对昭杺柠的担忧，百里魇自信开口。

他红眸危险盯着昭杺柠，低声笑问：“我听说你当着整个问天宗的面，自称是钟离珟的未婚妻？”

“你是不是忘记了，跟你有天道姻缘的人是本尊。”

“你的未婚夫，也是本尊。”

“咳咳，这个……那个……”面对百里魇的质问，昭杺柠内心慌得不行。

毕竟这个游戏修仙世界，出现过的天道姻缘都是一对一。

确实没出现过，一个女人，可以同时绑定多个男人的天道姻缘。

而且星灵大陆的人，也都是默认一夫一妻。

百里魇知道自己跟昭杺柠是天道姻缘，自然就不会想到昭杺柠除了跟他有姻缘，还跟另外五个男人也有姻缘。

但这些关系，昭杺柠自然是不会主动提起的。

此刻，昭杺柠心中疯狂想着怎么将百里魇忽悠过去。

系统见昭杺柠踩着的六条船即将要翻了一条，更是幸灾乐祸：

【哈哈哈哈，宿主现在害怕了吧，我叫你退婚你还不同意】

【宿主，之前跟你提过的，将姻缘红线换成被追杀黑线的权限还在，你现在选择换线还来得及】

【宿主，别怪我没提醒你，没有男人能忍受自己被戴绿帽，人家百里魇还是魔尊，身份尊贵，更不可能忍了】

“你闭嘴吧，遇见困难你帮不上忙还嘴贱，我就说你这系统当都当不明白，小心哪天被主神销毁了。”

昭杺柠慌乱之际，还有攻击力怼回系统几句。

Page (1/3)

"Baili Nightmare!" Zhao Hao Ning stared at the man approaching and exclaimed.

When she realized that she was now asking the Tianzong, she was so frightened that she quickly raised her hand to cover her mouth and asked Baili Xiang in a low voice: "I'm a demon, this is the Wentianzong, how dare you come here?"

Zhao Hao Ning was deeply impressed by Baili Xiang's true appearance.

Although when the two first met, Baili Xiang was disguised as a beggar and could not see his appearance clearly.

But Zhao Hao Ning still remembers how she entered the world of game cultivation.

It was all because of the beautiful posters of the six male protagonists that seduced her.

Otherwise, she wouldn't have been obsessed with sex for a while and ended up being bound by the system to travel through time.

"Don't worry, no one from Wentian Sect will find out that I am here." Facing Zhao Hao Ning's worries, Baili Xiang spoke confidently.

He stared dangerously at Zhao Hao Ning with his red eyes, and asked with a low smile: "I heard that you claimed to be Zhong Lizui's fiancée in front of the entire Wentian Sect?"

"Have you forgotten that the person with whom you are destined to be destined by heaven is me?"

"Your fiancé is also me."

"Ahem, this... that..." Faced with Baili Xiang's question, Zhao Hao Ning was extremely panicked.

After all, in this game's world of cultivating immortals, all the heavenly marriages that have appeared are one-to-one.

It has indeed never happened that a woman can be bound to the heavenly marriages of multiple men at the same time.

Moreover, people in the Protoss Continent also default to monogamy.

Baili Xiang knew that he and Zhao Hao Ning were destined to be married, so naturally he would not have thought that Zhao Hao Ning was not only married to him, but also to five other men.

But naturally, Zhao Hao Ning would not take the initiative to mention these relationships.

At this moment, Zhao Haining was frantically thinking about how to fool Baili Xiang over.

The system saw that one of the six boats Zhao Hao Ning was stepping on was about to capsize, and it even gloated:

[Hahahaha, the host must be scared now, I asked you to break off the engagement and you still don’t agree]

[Host, as I mentioned to you before, the authority to change the red line of marriage to the black line of being hunted is still there. You still have time to choose to change the line now]

[Host, don’t blame me for not reminding you, no man can endure being cuckolded. Baili Xiang is still a demon king with a noble status, so it’s even more impossible for him to endure it]

"Shut up. If you're in trouble and you can't help but you're being mean, I'll tell you that you don't even understand this system. Be careful of being destroyed by the Lord God one day."

When Zhao Hao Ning was in panic, he still had enough attack power to reply to the system.
